name: stream
title: sound.stream
lead: A live stream (MP3, or an FLV's sound) or a pack's sound file (OGG, MP3, WAV), heard through the mod a screen's stream uses. With `at`, from speakers: each player hears every speaker within `distance`. Without, from no place, at one volume. `to`: only these players. `loop`: files only.
signature: sound.stream(opts: { url: string ?, file: string ?, at: (SoundSpeaker | { SoundSpeaker })?, to: (Player | { Player })?, distance: number ?, loop: boolean ?, name: string ?, }) → SoundStream

params.name: opts
params.type: { url: string ?, file: string ?, at: ( SoundSpeaker | { SoundSpeaker })?, to: ( Player | { Player })?, distance: number ?, loop: boolean ?, name: string ?, }
